title: Recirculating pump.
officialText:
Where a thermostatic mixing valve is used in a system with a hot water recirculating pump, the hot
water or tempered water return line shall be routed to the cold water inlet pipe of the water heater and the cold water inlet pipe or
the hot water return connection of the thermostatic mixing valve.
